newsitem.title: USA: Air Jamaica adds freighters to open new facility.
newsitem.headline: Air Jamaica adds freighters to open new facility.

text.p: Air Jamaica has announced an expansion in its schedule to include 5 weekly DC-8 freighter flights from Miami to Montego Bay and Kingston beginning May 1.
It currently operates three DC-8 freighters a week.
The carrier said the additional airlift gives it over 50,000 lbs weekly on freighter flights and 60,000 lbs on its passenger flights southbound and northbound.
On April 28 Air Jamaica relocates to a new and larger Miami Cargo Centre with 38,000 sq ft of warehouse space an increase of 23,000 sq ft over its existing space.
The company said the move is in conjunction with the expanded services.

"Air Jamaica's Miami Cargo Facility handled over 30,000,000 lbs. of cargo I 1996, and with this larger facility and enhanced services, we are well on our way to surpassing that number in 1997," said Orville Hart, Air Jamaica Cargo Sales Manager, Florida.
